comment: Ceiling for the module graph a cold Notice boot must fetch before the application reports itself ready. Measured by tools/notice_cold_path.mjs; enforced by test/notice_cold_path.test.mjs. Reintroducing a lens group the Notice route never shows fails here rather than in a report months later. Measured on the change that added the Contracts/Land/Exams/Staffing/Meetings entries to the loader's route gate: 137 modules, 2059859 bytes, 59 serial request stages, down from 174 modules, 2735938 bytes and 71 stages.
